unit: U1 world & jungle planes (world + SCION #44 Multiplane + #29 GrabCut)
how_to_use: import world-build/compose.py functions (run with argv [world dir, swarm dir]): render(cam, t, framing, shot, water_y, occupant_u, defl, hand) returns the 800x540 world plate with P0-P2 and P3/P4 (wide) or near dressing (close); the editor/U2 should draw puppets, bag and shoe on P2 between plank/liana and the P3/P4 pass (pass p2_cb=lambda C, cam: ... to render(); it runs after plank and liana, before P3/P4 or the near dressing) using the same cam via project_pt(). Cameras: cam_glide(t) L-S1/E-S1, cam_push(t) L-S4, cam_close(centre,M) for L-S5/E-S4/L-S6 (values in world-scene.json). water_y(t), plank occupant u and deflection come from world-trace.json.

grabcut_qa.no_background_islands: cleanup() keeps the main component plus components >= 0.4-20 % of it; removed: P1_ficus_roots 22, P4_root_diag 0, P1b_flange 2, P3_treefern 0, P3b_treefern_mass 2, P1d_liana 13, P1c_flood_trunk 13
grabcut_qa.pinnae_kept: tree-fern cuts fill only holes < 40 px, so the gaps between pinnae stay open (P3_treefern, P3b_treefern_mass); P3d keeps the test-shot dark-pinnae key
grabcut_qa.failure_masks: every cut writes <piece>_fail.png (GrabCut probable-background pixels inside the working region); shown under each piece in world-sheet.jpg
known_defects: P1_ficus_roots: straight GrabCut edge on the left where the litter seed polygon cut the root skirt (hidden behind the N bank and P4 in the wide; visible as a darker column at x~120-150)
P1c_flood_trunk: the cut stops where the canopy starts; it is placed with its top above the frame so the stop is never seen in the wide
P1d_liana: keyed dark object; some sky gaps along its edge were kept as part of the liana (13 islands removed)

grading.rule: one monotone linear curve per plate, p2/p98 (of the cut piece's own pixels) -> L35/220, Rec.601 luminance, neutral (R=G=B); lighting is a uniform per-piece gain in the scene graph, no gradients, no grain, no vignette
grading.upscale_check: place() asserts screen scale <= 1.6 x download resolution for every piece and framing; max measured: wide 1.6, close 1.5 (the archive ripple field is the 1.6 case)

scene_graph_summary.planes: P0 z 6.667 ratio 0.15 | P1 z 2.857 ratio 0.35 | P2 z 1 ratio 1.0 | P3 z 0.667 ratio 1.5 | P4 z 0.5 ratio 2.0
scene_graph_summary.projection: screen = O + m (p - O - (X,Y)/z), m = z/(z-D), O=(400,270)

cameras.L_S1: lateral glide R->L, X 30 -> -30 (60 px at P2; P0 9 px, P1 21, P3 90, P4 120), smoothstep over 3 s
cameras.L_S5_and_E_S4: close: dolly M=3.0 at P2 centred on world (205,330), window x 72-338 y 240-420; P0 x1.11, P1 x1.30; P3/P4 behind camera -> near dressing (tree-fern crown right, heart leaf top left, root diagonal low left)
cameras.L_S6: close two-shot: M=2.85 centred on (140,250), window y 155-345 (standing heads at y ~149-191 -> head 0.22 H if the puppet head is 42 px wide-scale)

scene_graph_summary.puppet_scale_note: for head >= 0.25 H in L-S5 at M=3.0 the puppet head must be >= 45 px at the wide scale (0.45 H figure = 243 px tall); U2 sets the rig scale accordingly or the editor raises M to 3.4 with the centre at (205,345)

world_trace.water: level_y(t) = 416 - min(0.5 t, 18) (P2 px; +18 at L 36 s, +15 at E 30 s)
world_trace.plank: p0 (170,392) N -> p1 (690,384) F, span 520 px, 12 px thick; 2-segment kink under the occupant, depth D_max(load) sin(pi u): A 9, A+bag 9.5, B 7.5, B+bag 8, C 8.5; empty-plank spring 2 px exp(-dt/0.25) cos(6 pi dt) after each step-off
world_trace.liana: anchors (-40,40) and (860,20), rest mid (410,118); pulled to the occupant's hand
world_trace.banks: N polygon (-60,396)...(236,440)...(-60,560); F polygon (688,384)...(860,560); stations per version in world-trace.json 'stations'
world_trace.last_crosser_clearance: L: B 4.03 px (plank 12 px thick, so its underside is in the water at mid-span); E: C 5.74 px; baseline: C 8.95 px
asserted_every_frame: 2 hands each; occupant has exactly one on the liana
one bag holder; holder changes only at logged events

test_frame_stats.gradient_definition: mean(|dL/dx|+|dL/dy|) at native resolution; reference 14.36 at 1000x677 (16.69 at 800x541); the test-shot compare used mean hypot(np.gradient) (reference 9.72) -- not comparable
test_frame_stats.reading: measured: neutral (|R-B| 0), lifted blacks (p1 31-32), p50 98-103, p95 201, >L200 5.2 % (ref 6.3), gradient 18.9 wide / 12.4 close (ref 14.4, kf-1 4.65). Short of the reference: p75 144-153 (ref 161) and the dark share <L60 15-17 % (ref 25 %); the canopy rows are 94-100 vs 89-90. Puppets (dark trousers, mud) will add dark share in the centre; perceptually: soft overcast mid-grey, no sky, frame crammed with root, fern, leaf -- judged by this unit only, needs the independent critic.
